Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                   ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all ofthe B1-2 Neighborhood
Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map Number 6-G in the
area bounded by:

      A line 605.5 feet south of and parallel to West 29"^ Street; South Halsted
      Street; a line 101.9 feet north of and parallel to West 31^' Street; and a line
      beginning at a point 47.44 feet west of South Halsted Street and 101.9
      feet north of West 31®' Street and continuing northwesterly to a point
      361.67 feet west of South Halsted Street and 605.5 feet south of West 29"^
      Street

to those of a B3-2 Community Shopping District, and a corresponding use district
is hereby established in the area above described.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its
passage and due publication.
